# Compiler 25 controls for preserved predecessor meaning

These derived controls retain the original source and instruction forms from
`../requirement-predecessor/`, `../transaction-outcome-predecessor/` and
`../cell-participation-predecessor/`. Derived envelopes use compiler 25, bytecode
20 and artifact 32 with compiler meaning contract Graph 25. Original source
generations, package identities and semantic revisions remain unchanged.

The test-only owner is
`platform::compiler::tests::predecessor_attack_tests::current_predecessor_controls_retain_exact_source_and_instructions`.
It requires each original's exact format refusal, decodes frozen instructions
without changing operands or order, independently admits every current control,
and probes it against its exact original source transport. Runtime metadata may
select additional records already present in that frozen source; it cannot
synthesize or edit canonical owners. The final assertion compares complete
generated bytes against these retained controls.

`179dbbf0cf4797d1fe6238d8d4198f5333b45c5bea0dccb2546f835c55ae33bc`.
